words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.tr:
n. 营地；
v. 宿营；露营；
words.ex: The children set up a camp near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边搭了一个营地。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: He wore a strange hat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去学校。
words.en: If something is strange, it is unusual or unexpected, and makes you feel slightly nervous or afraid.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.ex: He lives in a small town near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小镇上。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.ex: He took a deep breath before jumping.
words.ex_cn: 他跳之前深吸了一口气。
words.en: The air taken into the lungs and then expelled.

words.tr: phrase. 令人惊叹不已；使人屏息（形容某事物美得惊人或令人震撼）
words.ex: The view from the mountain takes my breath away.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色让我惊叹不已。
words.en: To amaze or astonish someone to the point where they are momentarily unable to speak or react, often because of beauty, surprise, or awe.

words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.tr: phrase. 清蒸鸡汤；用蒸的方式烹制的鸡肉汤
words.ex: She made steamed chicken soup for her sick brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为生病的哥哥做了蒸鸡汤。
words.en: A clear, savory soup made by steaming chicken, often with herbs and vegetables, known for its delicate flavor.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.tr:
pron. 没有什么；
n. 无关紧要的事；
words.ex: I have nothing to say.
words.ex_cn: 我没什么可说的。
words.en: Nothing means not anything or no single thing.

words.tr:
n. 导游；指南；向导；
v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guide showed us the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古庙。
words.en: A guide is someone who shows other people the way to a place in a difficult or unknown region. A guide is also a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

words.ex: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 山景非常美丽。
words.en: The natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance, especially when picturesque.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 我准备好考试了。
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.tr: phrase. 准备好做某事；愿意做某事；随时可以去做某事
words.ex: He is ready to start the test.
words.ex_cn: 他准备好了开始考试。
words.en: Prepared or willing to perform a specific action or task.

words.ex: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙落在房子的某个地方了。
words.en: In or to some place.

words.ex: I did it myself.
words.ex_cn: 我自己做的。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself as the object of a verb or preposition when he or she is the subject of the clause.

words.ex: He has nothing but praise for his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师只有赞美。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is only what you say it is and nothing more

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；烦闷的；厌倦的； v. 钻孔；“bore”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt bored during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: If you are bored, you feel tired and impatient because you have lost interest in something or because you have nothing to do.

words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

words.ex: He walked towards the park.
words.ex_cn: 他朝公园走去。
words.en: In the direction of; with a tendency to; in relation to; for the purpose of.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后出现了彩虹。
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: He slept during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在看电影时睡着了。
words.en: Throughout the course or duration of (a period of time).

words.ex: The team celebrated their victory after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球队庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A victory is a success in a struggle, war, or competition.

words.tr:
adj. 俄国的；
n. 俄语；
words.ex: He loves Russian music and food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢俄罗斯的音乐和食物。
words.en: Relating to Russia, its people, or their language.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.tr: prep. 反对；与…相反；倚着；违反；碰；对着；
words.ex: He spoke against the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: In opposition to; contrary to; in contact with.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与某人或某事物作斗争；反对某人或某事物
words.ex: He fights against bullying at school.
words.ex_cn: 他与校园欺凌作斗争。
words.en: To oppose or struggle with someone or something.

words.ex: The museum displayed many beautiful artworks.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了许多精美的艺术品。
words.en: Artwork refers to the pieces of art that are produced by artists, including paintings, sculptures, and other forms of visual art.

words.ex: Thousands of people attended the concert.
words.ex_cn: 数千人参加了这场音乐会。
words.en: A large number of something, typically more than a thousand.

words.tr:
n. 眼泪；泪水；
v. 撕裂；撕开；
words.ex: A tear fell down her cheek when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当她听到这个消息时，一滴眼泪从脸颊滑落。
words.en: A tear is a drop of clear salty liquid that is produced by the glands in your eyes when you cry or when your eyes are irritated.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.ex: He can solve the problem easily.
words.ex_cn: 他很容易就能解决这个问题。
words.en: Without difficulty or effort.

words.ex: I forget where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you forget something, you fail to remember it.

words.ex: We eat lunch at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Noon is the middle of the day, 12 o'clock in the daytime.

words.ex: He is sick and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick can also mean feeling nauseous or wanting to vomit. Additionally, it can describe being very tired of something or someone because you have experienced too much of them.

words.ex: He takes the metro to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A metro is an underground railway system in a city.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.ex: He plays the accordion at the street festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在街头音乐节上演奏手风琴。
words.en: An accordion is a musical instrument that you play by pressing keys or buttons on one side and pulling and pushing a bellows on the other side to force air through reeds, producing notes.

words.ex: We get together every weekend to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末聚在一起打篮球。
words.en: If people get together, they meet in order to spend time with each other.

words.tr: phrase. 在阳光下；处于阳光之中
words.ex: The cat sleeps in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 猫在阳光下睡觉。
words.en: Exposed to or illuminated by the sun's rays.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.tr: v. 可能；也许；“may”的过去式； n. 强大力量；
words.ex: He might come to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚可能会来参加派对。
words.en: Might is used to indicate that something is possible or might happen, or to ask for permission in a polite way.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: He is forgetful and often loses his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他很健忘，经常丢钥匙。
words.en: Someone who is forgetful often forgets things.

words.ex: The faraway village is hard to reach.
words.ex_cn: 那个遥远的村庄很难到达。
words.en: A faraway place is a long distance away from where you are.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.tr: phrase. 转身；（使）好转；（使）扭转局面
words.ex: He heard a noise and told me to turn around.
words.ex_cn: 他听到一声响动，叫我转过身来。
words.en: To change direction so as to face the opposite way; to change something bad into something good.

words.tr: adj. 感到惊讶的； v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；“surprise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was surprised when I saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到礼物时，我感到很惊讶。
words.en: If you are surprised, you have a feeling of surprise, because something unexpected has happened.

words.ex: A deer is walking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹿正在森林里走路。
words.en: A deer is a large wild animal that eats grass and leaves. The male has antlers that are shed and regrown each year.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 迎宾松（常用于指中国黄山著名的迎客松，象征热情接待宾客的松树）
words.ex: The guest-greeting pine stands near the front door.
words.ex_cn: 迎宾松树站在前门附近。
words.en: A pine tree traditionally planted to welcome guests, symbolizing hospitality.

words.ex: He saw a sea of clouds from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了一片云海。
words.en: A vast expanse of clouds, often resembling an ocean, especially in mountainous regions.

words.tr: phrase. 红场（莫斯科著名广场）；红色正方形
words.ex: Tourists visit the red square to see the Kremlin.
words.ex_cn: 游客们前往红场参观克里姆林宫。
words.en: A large square in central Moscow, Russia, known for its historical and cultural significance.

words.tr: n. 莫斯科（俄罗斯首都）
words.ex: He lives in Moscow.
words.ex_cn: 他住在莫斯科。
words.en: Moscow is the capital city of Russia, known for its significant role in Russian history and culture.

words.ex: He lives in Russia.
words.ex_cn: 他住在俄罗斯。
words.en: A country in Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, known for its vast territory and rich history.

words.tr: phrase. 胜利博物馆（专有名词，指以胜利为主题的博物馆）
words.ex: We visited the victory museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了胜利博物馆。
words.en: A museum dedicated to commemorating a victory, often in a historical or military context.

words.tr:
n. 纳粹党人
adj. 纳粹党的
words.ex: He hated the nazi regime.
words.ex_cn: 他憎恨纳粹政权。
words.en: A member of the National Socialist German Workers' Party, which controlled Germany from 1933 to 1945 under Adolf Hitler.

words.ex: He takes the Moscow Metro to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘莫斯科地铁去上班。
words.en: The underground railway system in Moscow, Russia, known for its ornate station designs.

words.ex: He lives in Scotland.
words.ex_cn: 他住在苏格兰。
words.en: Scotland is a country that is part of the United Kingdom, known for its distinct culture, history, and landscapes.

words.ex: The children are playing a game in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩游戏。
words.en: A game is an activity or sport usually involving skill, knowledge, or chance, in which you follow fixed rules and try to win against an opponent or to solve a puzzle.

words.tr: adj. 兴奋的； v. 使兴奋；使激动；“excite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children were excited about the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对派对感到兴奋。
words.en: If you are excited, you are so happy that you cannot relax, usually because you are thinking about something pleasant that you are going to do or experience.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户是玻璃做的。
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.tr:
n. 睡眠；
v. 睡觉；
words.ex: He needs more sleep to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他需要更多的睡眠来感觉好些。
words.en: Sleep is the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is inactive, and your mind is unconscious.

words.tr: v. 睡觉；“sleep”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He slept well last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚睡得很好。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of sleep.

words.tr:
v. 担心；担忧；
n. 担心；忧虑；
words.ex: She worries about her son every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天为她的儿子担心。
words.en: If you worry, you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在秋季落下。
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.tr: phrase. 第二次世界大战（1939–1945年）
words.ex: Many families lost loved ones in world war two.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭在第二次世界大战中失去了亲人。
words.en: A major global conflict that occurred from 1939 to 1945.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr: phrase. 打包； 收拾；停止工作； 出故障
words.ex: He will pack up his clothes tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会收拾好他的衣服。
words.en: To put things into cases or boxes so that they can be transported or stored; to stop working or operating.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.tr: phrase. 挂断；拖延；把...挂起来
words.ex: He hung up the phone after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵后，他挂断了电话。
words.en: To end a telephone conversation by breaking the connection; to suspend something from above so that it is supported only from above.

words.ex: She invited her friend to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请她的朋友吃晚饭。
words.en: To invite someone means to ask them to come to a social event or to spend time with you socially.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.ex: The arrival of the train was delayed by 20 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 火车的到达晚了20分钟。
words.en: The act of coming to a place or the moment when something or someone arrives.

words.tr:
adv. 还；然而；
conj. 然而；
words.ex: He hasn't finished his homework yet.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: You use yet in negative statements to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, although it probably will happen.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.tr: phrase. 将某物添加到某物中
words.ex: Please add sugar to the tea.
words.ex_cn: 请把糖加到茶里。
words.en: To put something with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.ex: He hunts deer in the forest every autumn.
words.ex_cn: 他每年秋天在森林里打猎。
words.en: To hunt means to chase and try to catch or kill animals for food or sport.

words.tr: phrase. 寻宝游戏；寻宝活动
words.ex: The children went on a treasure hunt in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里进行寻宝游戏。
words.en: A game in which players search for hidden objects or clues to find a prize.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.tr: 短语动词. 搭载某人一程；让某人搭便车
words.ex: He gave me a lift to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他载我去车站。
words.en: To give someone a ride in a vehicle to their destination.

words.tr:
prep. 到…时；直到…为止；
conj. 到…时；直到…为止；
words.ex: He waited until the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到公交车来。
words.en: Up to the time of; before (a specified time).

words.ex: Be careful with the glass, it can break easily.
words.ex_cn: 小心那块玻璃，它很容易碎。
words.en: To handle something with caution or to be cautious in one's actions or words.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.tr: phrase. 电影；电影院（口语中常指去看电影或泛指电影行业）
words.ex: We went to the movies last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: The term 'the movies' refers to the cinema or films collectively, often used to describe the experience of watching films in a theater or as a general term for the film industry.

words.tr:
adj. 死的；
n. 死人；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The dead bird lay on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 那只死鸟躺在地上。
words.en: No longer alive; deprived of life.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: He takes notes during the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时做笔记。
words.en: To write down information, especially during a lecture or meeting, in order to remember it later.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.ex: He almost finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎完成了作业。
words.en: You use almost to indicate that something is not completely the case but is nearly the case.

words.ex: They went on a long journey by train.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when this involves a long distance or a lot of time.

words.tr:
v. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
n. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
words.ex: He pull the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他拉开了门。
words.en: To pull something means to use your hands to make it move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving.

words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.ex: Ah, I see what you mean.
words.ex_cn: 啊，我明白你的意思了。
words.en: used to express surprise, pleasure, or sympathy

words.ex: He shares his lunch with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友分享他的午餐。
words.en: Give or allow someone to use something you possess.

words.tr: int. 嗯（表示思考或犹豫）
words.ex: Hmm, I'm not sure if I should go.
words.ex_cn: 嗯，我不确定我是否该去。
words.en: Used to express agreement, understanding, or contemplation.

words.ex: I am familiar with this song.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这首歌。
words.en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

words.tr:
n. 笑话；玩笑；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: He told a funny joke at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上讲了一个有趣的笑话。
words.en: A joke is something that is said or done to make people laugh, especially a funny story or a trick played on someone.

words.tr:
pron. 几个；一些；
adj. 不同的；
words.ex: I have several books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上放着几本书。
words.en: Several means a number of people or things that is more than a few but not a lot.

words.tr:
v. 点头；打盹
n. 点头
words.ex: He nodded when I asked if he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 当我问他是否累了时，他点了点头。
words.en: If you nod, you move your head downwards and upwards to show that you are answering 'yes' to a question, or to show agreement, understanding, or approval.

words.ex: He is a writer who loves to write stories.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位喜欢写故事的作家。
words.en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job or regular occupation.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: You can leave your bag wherever you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以把包放在任何你喜欢的地方。
words.en: in or to any place; in any case or situation

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.ex: No matter how tired I am, I finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 无论我多么累，我都会完成作业。
words.en: used to say that something is not important or does not affect the situation

words.ex: Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 或许明天会下雨。
words.en: You use perhaps to express uncertainty, for example, when you do not know that something is definitely true, or when you are mentioning something that may possibly happen in the future in the way you describe.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: She ate the freshly baked bread.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了刚烤好的面包。
words.en: Recently; just now.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.ex: The children screamed with joy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们因喜悦而尖叫。
words.en: Joy is a feeling of great happiness.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: She scissored the paper into two pieces.
words.ex_cn: 她把纸剪成了两半。
words.en: To cut something with scissors.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: He made a bird with paper-cut.
words.ex_cn: 他用剪纸做了一只鸟。
words.en: A traditional form of Chinese folk art that involves cutting paper into decorative designs and figures.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: Be careful when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: If you are careful, you give serious attention to what you are doing, in order to avoid harm, damage, or mistakes.

words.tr:
n. 明天；
adv. 在明天；
words.ex: I will go to school tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天去学校。
words.en: The day after today; in the future.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: The shy boy didn't speak in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩在课堂上没有说话。
words.en: If you are shy, you are nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

words.ex: He is lazy and doesn't like to do homework.
words.ex_cn: 他很懒，不喜欢做作业。
words.en: If someone is lazy, they are not willing to work or use any effort to do something.

words.tr:
adj. 响亮的；大声的；
adv. 大声地；
words.ex: The music was too loud at the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对上的音乐太响了。
words.en: If a noise is loud, the level of sound is very high and it can be easily heard.

words.tr: adj. 外向的；即将离职的；往外去的；
words.ex: He is an outgoing boy who loves talking to new people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个外向的男孩，喜欢和新朋友聊天。
words.en: Someone who is outgoing is very friendly and likes meeting and talking to people.

words.tr: adj. 勤勉的；努力工作的
words.ex: He is hard-working and always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很勤奋，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is hard-working always puts a lot of effort and care into their work.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在公园里散步。
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.

words.ex: He plays the flute every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吹长笛。
words.en: A flute is a musical instrument of the woodwind family. You play it by blowing over a hole at one end while holding it sideways.

words.ex: He sent her a card with congratulations.
words.ex_cn: 他给她寄了一张写有祝贺的卡片。
words.en: an expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune

words.ex: Congratulations on your graduation!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你毕业！
words.en: An expression of pleasure or joy in the success or good fortune of another.

words.tr:
n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；
v. 珍视；
words.ex: He won a prize for the best science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因最好的科学项目获得了奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.tr: conj. 和……一样；如同……一样（用于比较）
words.ex: He runs as fast as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得和他哥哥一样快。
words.en: Used to compare two things as being equal in a specified quality.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.tr: n. 业余时间；空闲时间
words.ex: He reads books in his sparetime.
words.ex_cn: 他在业余时间读书。
words.en: Time not occupied by work or duties; leisure.

words.ex: Reading gives me great pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 阅读带给我极大的快乐。
words.en: Pleasure is a feeling of happiness, satisfaction, or enjoyment.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有共同之处；有共同点
words.ex: Tom and I have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 我和汤姆没有任何共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；认真的；严肃的；
words.ex: The accident caused a serious injury.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故造成了严重的伤害。
words.en: If you are serious about something, you are sincere about it and mean what you say.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.ex: The fact is that he was late.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他迟到了。
words.en: A fact is a piece of information that is known to be true.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr: 名词短语，表示距离为50公里
words.ex: The town is 50 km from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇离城市50公里。
words.en: Fifty kilometers, a unit of distance equal to approximately 31 miles.

words.ex: The school is five kilometres from my house.
words.ex_cn: 学校离我家五公里。
words.en: A kilometre is a unit of length equal to 1,000 metres, or approximately 0.621 miles.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: The cost is $5 per hour.
words.ex_cn: 每小时费用是5美元。
words.en: Used to express the rate at which something happens or the means by which something is done.

words.tr: int. 嗯（表示思考或犹豫）
words.ex: Hmm, I'm not sure if I should go.
words.ex_cn: 嗯，我不确定我是否该去。
words.en: Used to express agreement, understanding, or contemplation.

words.ex: The worm is five millimetres long.
words.ex_cn: 这条虫子五毫米长。
words.en: A millimetre is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to one thousandth of a metre.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；舒适的；讨人喜欢的
words.ex: The weather was pleasant today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气很愉快。
words.en: Pleasant; enjoyable.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.tr:
n. 意义；感知；理解力；知觉；
v. 感觉到；觉察出；意识到；
words.ex: The story has no sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事没有意义。
words.en: A sense is a feeling or awareness about something, or a physical ability such as sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.

words.ex: His humour makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让每个人都笑起来。
words.en: Humour is the quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.ex: He passed the test thanks to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为努力学习而通过了考试。
words.en: Because of; due to.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: I make a mistake when I write the wrong number.
words.ex_cn: 我写错数字时犯了一个错误。
words.en: To do something incorrectly or make an error.

words.tr: adj. 诚实的；正直的；坦率的；
words.ex: He gave an honest answer to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向老师给出了一个诚实的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone as honest, you mean that they always tell the truth, and do not try to deceive people or break the law.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.ex: The similarity between the two paintings is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这两幅画的相似点很明显。
words.en: The quality or state of being similar; likeness or resemblance.

words.ex: Their friendship lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的友谊持续了二十年。
words.en: A friendship is a relationship between two or more friends.

words.ex: The table is two metres long.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子两米长。
words.en: A metre is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to 100 centimetres.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: The pauper lived in a small hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个穷人住在一间小屋里。
words.en: A pauper is someone who is extremely poor and has very little money or possessions.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.tr: n. 事故；意外事件；意外；
words.ex: He was hurt in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中受伤了。
words.en: An accident is an unexpected and undesirable event, especially one resulting in damage or harm.

words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: I expect a gift on my birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我期待在生日时收到一份礼物。
words.en: If you expect something, you believe that it is likely to happen or that it will be the case.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.tr: n. 衬里；内衬；衬层； v. 排队；加衬里；“line”的现在分词；
words.ex: The coat has a soft lining for warmth.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套有柔软的衬里以保暖。
words.en: A lining is a layer of material that is fixed to the inside of something in order to protect it or make it warmer.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.ex: He cares about his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他关心他的朋友。
words.en: To be concerned about or interested in.

words.tr:
v. 达到；抵达；
n. 伸手可及的距离；
words.ex: He reached his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，他达到了自己的目标。
words.en: To reach means to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort traveling. It can also mean to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to achieve a goal or a standard.

words.ex: He reaches for the book on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他伸手去拿书架上的书。
words.en: To extend out an arm or hand in order to touch or grasp something; to strive to achieve or obtain something.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.tr: phrase. 帮某人一把；给予某人帮助
words.ex: Can you lend me a hand with the boxes?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我搬一下这些箱子吗？
words.en: To help someone.

words.ex: He lives in Chicago.
words.ex_cn: 他住在芝加哥。
words.en: Chicago is a large city in the northeastern Illinois on Lake Michigan, known for its vibrant arts scene, architectural landmarks, and deep-dish pizza.

words.tr:
adj. 缓慢的；迟钝的；
v. 使减速；
words.ex: The slow car moved across the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 那辆缓慢的车驶过桥。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving only at a low speed; not fast.

words.ex: The stone is covered with green moss.
words.ex_cn: 石头上覆盖着绿色的苔藓。
words.en: Moss is a small, green plant that grows in damp, shady places, often forming a soft, thick layer on the ground, trees, or rocks.

words.ex: The redwood trees are very tall.
words.ex_cn: 红杉树非常高。
words.en: A redwood is a very tall tree that grows in California, known for its height and longevity.

words.ex: The cheetah runs very fast in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 猎豹在野外跑得非常快。
words.en: A cheetah is a large, slender, spotted cat found in Africa and parts of Iran. It is the fastest land animal, capable of running at speeds up to about 100 kilometers per hour (62 miles per hour) in short bursts covering distances up to 500 meters (1,600 feet), and has the ability to accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h (62 mph) in just three seconds.

words.tr: v. 折叠；交叠；“fold”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is folding the paper into a crane.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把纸折叠成一只鹤。
words.en: 1. capable of being folded into a more compact shape. 2. the action of folding something.

words.tr: phrase. 折扇；可折叠的扇子
words.ex: She holds a folding fan to cool herself.
words.ex_cn: 她拿着一把折扇来让自己凉快。
words.en: A fan made of material that can be folded.

words.ex: He made a basket from bamboo.
words.ex_cn: 他用竹子做了一个篮子。
words.en: Bamboo is a tall tropical plant with hard, hollow stems. The young shoots of the plant can be eaten and the stems are used to make furniture.

words.tr: phrase. 是的；对；嗯（非正式表达）
words.ex: Yeah, I want to go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 是的，我想去公园。
words.en: An informal expression of agreement or affirmation.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.ex: Goodness, I didn't expect to see you here!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我没料到会在这里见到你！
words.en: Goodness is the quality of being kind, helpful, and honest.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr: adv. 事实上；实际上；竟然；
words.ex: I thought he was late, but actually he was on time.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上他准时到了。
words.en: You use actually to indicate that a situation exists or happened, or to emphasize that it is true.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.ex: The sun appears in the sky at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在黎明时出现。
words.en: If someone or something appears, they come into sight or become noticeable.

words.tr: 短语动词. 意思是‘随意做某事’，表示允许或鼓励对方无拘束地采取行动
words.ex: Feel free to ask me any question.
words.ex_cn: 随时问我任何问题。
words.en: You are welcome to do something; do it without hesitation.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.tr:
adj. 非洲的；非洲人的；
n. 非洲人；
words.ex: He loves African music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢非洲的音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Relating to Africa or its people, culture, or languages.

words.tr: n. 玫瑰； v. 上升；提高；“rise”的过去式；
words.ex: She picked a red rose from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵红玫瑰。
words.en: A rose is a flower, often with a pleasant smell, which grows on a bush with thorns on the stems.

words.ex: She planted a peony in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种了一株牡丹。
words.en: A peony is a type of garden plant with large round pink, red, or white flowers.

words.ex: The lotus grows in the muddy pond.
words.ex_cn: 莲花生长在泥泞的池塘里。
words.en: A lotus is a type of water lily with large, flat leaves and white, pink, or yellow flowers. It is often regarded as a symbol of purity and enlightenment in various cultures.

words.ex: A butterfly is flying over the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝴蝶在花上飞舞。
words.en: A butterfly is an insect with large, often brightly coloured wings.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: The frog jumps over the pond.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跳过池塘。
words.en: A frog is a small creature with smooth skin, big eyes, and long back legs, which it uses for jumping. Frogs live in or near water.

words.ex: The doctor will weigh the baby at the clinic.
words.ex_cn: 医生将在诊所称量婴儿的体重。
words.en: To weigh something means to measure how heavy it is, usually by using scales. It can also mean to consider something carefully before making a decision.

words.ex: The bag weighs 5 kg.
words.ex_cn: 这个包重5公斤。
words.en: A unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

words.ex: The apple weighs one kilogram.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果重一公斤。
words.en: A kilogram is a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

words.ex: The ginkgo tree turns yellow in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 银杏树在秋天变黄。
words.en: A ginkgo is a tree with fan-shaped leaves and yellow flowers, which is native to China and is often planted in parks and gardens.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.ex: He takes a walk after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后去散步。
words.en: To go for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: The bridge connects the two cities.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接了两座城市。
words.en: If something or someone connects one thing to another, or if one thing connects to another, the two things are joined together.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；连接的； v. 连接；“connect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are connected.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是相关的。
words.en: If one thing is connected with another, there is a link or relationship between them.

words.tr: phrase. 与……有联系；与……有关联；连接到……
words.ex: He is connected with the local school.
words.ex_cn: 他与当地学校有联系。
words.en: To have a relationship or association with something.

words.ex: He cannot swim without water.
words.ex_cn: 没有水，他不会游泳。
words.en: If you do something without something else, you do not have that thing with you or you do not use that thing.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.ex: She put honey on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上涂了蜂蜜。
words.en: Honey is a sweet, sticky, yellowish-brown fluid made by bees and other insects from nectar collected from flowers.

words.tr: adj. 失望的；沮丧的； v. “disappoint”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was disappointed when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格时感到很失望。
words.en: If you are disappointed, you are sad because something has not happened or because something is not as good as you had hoped.

words.ex: The connection between the two wires is loose.
words.ex_cn: 两根电线之间的连接松了。
words.en: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

words.ex: Bees help with pollination of flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂帮助花朵授粉。
words.en: The transfer of pollen from an anther to a stigma; thereby enabling fertilization and sexual reproduction in plants.

words.ex: Bees collect pollen from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花粉。
words.en: Pollen is a fine powder produced by flowers, which is carried by the wind or insects to other flowers of the same species, causing them to produce seeds.

words.ex: The government took quick action to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 政府迅速采取行动解决问题。
words.en: The fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.ex: Fifty per cent of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 百分之五十的学生通过了考试。
words.en: In mathematics, a percentage is a number or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100. It is often denoted using the percent sign, "%".

words.tr: phrase. 由于这个原因；因此
words.ex: He forgot his homework, for this reason he was late.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了作业，因此迟到了。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that explains why something has happened or is the case.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.tr:
n. 蜂窝；蜂窝状物
v. 使布满小孔；成蜂窝状
words.ex: Bees build their nest in a honeycomb shape.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜂窝形状建造它们的巢。
words.en: A honeycomb is a structure of hexagonal cells made by bees, used to store honey and pollen or to house their eggs and larvae.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.tr: phrase. 起作用；参与；扮演角色
words.ex: Every student can play a part in making the school better.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都能在改善学校方面起作用。
words.en: To contribute to or be involved in a particular activity or outcome.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.tr:
adj. 人的；人类的；
n. 人；人类；
words.ex: Human emotions are complex and powerful.
words.ex_cn: 人的情感复杂而强大。
words.en: A human is a member of the species Homo sapiens, distinguished from other animals by superior mental development, power of articulate speech, and upright stance.

words.ex: An ant is carrying a leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚂蚁正在搬一片叶子。
words.en: A small insect, often with a sting, that lives in a complex social colony with one or more breeding queens. It is wingless except for fertile adults, which form large mating swarms, and is proverbial for its industriousness.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某人来说是家；让某人感到安心或自在的地方
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是许多鸟的家园。
words.en: To be the place where someone lives or belongs.

words.ex: Children find happiness in simple games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在简单的游戏中找到幸福。
words.en: Happiness is a state of well-being and contentment.

words.ex: He disappointed his parents by failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他考试不及格，让父母失望了。
words.en: If things or people disappoint you, they are not as good as you had hoped, or do not do what you expected them to do.

words.ex: He picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里摘了一朵野生蘑菇。
words.en: A mushroom is a fungus that grows in damp, dark places and has a stem with a rounded top.

words.ex: He lifted a ton of bricks yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天搬了一吨砖。
words.en: A ton is a unit of weight equal to 2,240 pounds in Britain and 2,000 pounds in the United States. It is also used informally to mean a large amount of something.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: Exercise plays a role in keeping you healthy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼在保持健康方面起着作用。
words.en: To have a part or function in a particular situation or event.

words.ex: He eats a pea from his plate.
words.ex_cn: 他从盘子里吃了一颗豌豆。
words.en: A pea is a small, round, green seed which is eaten as a vegetable and which is formed in a pod on a climbing plant.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.tr: phrase. 达到（期望或标准）；不辜负（期望）
words.ex: He didn't live up to his parents' expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他没有达到父母的期望。
words.en: To meet expectations or standards.

words.tr: adj. 充满生机的；活泼的；
words.ex: The market is lively with people and music.
words.ex_cn: 市场里人来人往，音乐欢快，充满生机。
words.en: If you describe someone as lively, you mean they are full of life, energy, or enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 北极地区；北极圈内的区域
words.ex: Polar bears live in the arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: The Arctic is the region around the Earth's North Pole, opposite the Antarctic region around the South Pole.

words.ex: He is a big fan of soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他是足球的忠实粉丝。
words.en: A fan is a device that creates a current of air by the movement of its blades. It is also used to refer to a person who has a strong interest in and admiration for a particular person or thing.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.ex: The bee is flying near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂正在花附近飞舞。
words.en: A bee is a flying insect known for its role in pollination and for producing honey and beeswax.

words.tr:
adv. 远；极；
adj. 较远的；遥远的；
words.ex: He ran far from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得离房子很远。
words.en: At, to, or by a great distance (used to indicate the extent to which one thing is distant from another).

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 切碎；使伤心；使难过
words.ex: He cut up the apple into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果切成了小块。
words.en: To cut something into pieces; to injure someone by making cuts in their skin; to upset someone emotionally.

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.ex: She bakes bread every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周日都烤面包。
words.en: To bake is to cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.tr: phrase. 将某物倒入某物中；投入（时间、精力等）到某事中
words.ex: He pours money into his new business.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱投入他的新生意。
words.en: To add a liquid to something, often in large quantities.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.ex: The water begins to boil at 100 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 水在100度时开始沸腾。
words.en: When a liquid boils or when you boil it, it reaches the temperature at which it starts to turn into a gas.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.tr: phrase. v. 插入某物；打断；参与（某事）
words.ex: He cut the note in during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间插话了。
words.en: To divide something into parts or pieces.

words.tr: n. 大调羹，大汤匙；一餐匙的量
words.ex: He added one tablespoon of sugar to his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他往茶里加了一汤匙糖。
words.en: A tablespoon is a large spoon used for serving food, or the amount of food or liquid that such a spoon can hold.

words.ex: The brewery uses fresh mash to make beer.
words.ex_cn: 酿酒厂使用新鲜的麦芽浆来酿造啤酒。
words.en: To crush or smash something into a soft, pulpy mass.

words.tr:
adj. 捣烂的
v. 把...捣成糊状；“mash”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He ate mashed potatoes for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了土豆泥。
words.en: Mashed is used to describe something that has been crushed or beaten into a soft, pulpy mass.

words.tr:
v. 用旺火煸；用旺火炒
n. 炒出来的菜
adj. 煸炒的；爆炒的
words.ex: We make stir-fry with vegetables and rice.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蔬菜和米饭做炒菜。
words.en: To cook small pieces of food quickly by stirring them in a small amount of very hot oil.

words.tr: phrase. 与...相处；忍受；处理；与…有关；需要；想做
words.ex: I don't know how to do with him; he is always quiet.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道怎么和他相处；他总是很安静。
words.en: To have a connection or relevance to a particular subject or situation.

words.ex: He ate soup from a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃汤。
words.en: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are often used for washing or other purposes.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: She put oil on the pan before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她在锅里倒了油再做饭。
words.en: Oil is a liquid that is used as a fuel and for lubricating the moving parts of machines.

words.ex: He put the bread in the pan.
words.ex_cn: 他把面包放进平底锅里。
words.en: A pan is a round metal container with a long handle, which is used for cooking things in, usually on top of a stove.

words.tr: phrase. 把某物放回原处；推迟；延误；使倒退
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放回了架子上。
words.en: To return something to its original position.

words.tr: phrase. 把……与……混合；把……和……掺在一起
words.ex: He mixes water with juice.
words.ex_cn: 他把水和果汁混合在一起。
words.en: To combine or blend with something else.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.tr: adj. 蒸熟的； v. “steam”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The steamed fish tastes very fresh.
words.ex_cn: 蒸熟的鱼味道很新鲜。
words.en: Cooked by steam.

words.tr: phrase. 酸辣的；又辣又酸的（常用于描述菜肴，如‘酸辣汤’）
words.ex: She ate hot and sour soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她午餐吃了酸辣汤。
words.en: Having a spicy and tangy flavour.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很好。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.ex: We buy gifts for Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 我们为圣诞节买礼物。
words.en: Christmas is the period around the 25th of December when Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块煎饼。
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去划船；去乘船游玩
words.ex: They go boating on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末去划船。
words.en: To go boating means to go out in a boat for pleasure.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.tr: phrase. 和某人一起；伴随某人
words.ex: He went to the park along with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他和他哥哥一起去公园了。
words.en: In the company of someone.

words.ex: He carved a big pumpkin for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 他为万圣节雕刻了一个大南瓜。
words.en: A pumpkin is a large, round, orange vegetable with a thick skin.

words.ex: He ate a slice of apple pie for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块苹果派作为甜点。
words.en: A pie is a baked dish which is usually made of a pastry dough casing that contains a filling of various sweet or savoury ingredients.

words.tr: phrase. 热身；变暖；使活跃起来
words.ex: He warms up before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前热身。
words.en: To prepare for physical exertion or a performance by exercising or practicing gently beforehand.

words.ex: She added cinnamon to the cookies.
words.ex_cn: 她往饼干里加了肉桂。
words.en: Cinnamon is a spice obtained from the inner bark of several tree species from the genus Cinnamomum. It is used in both sweet and savory foods.

words.tr: phrase. 用……填满；使充满；装满（某物）
words.ex: He filled the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水把瓶子装满。
words.en: To make something full or complete.

words.ex: The sweetness of the honey made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜的甜蜜让她露出了微笑。
words.en: The quality of being sweet.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.tr: n. 女主人；女房东；女招待；女主持人；
words.ex: The hostess welcomed us with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 女主人微笑着欢迎我们。
words.en: A woman who receives or entertains guests in a social or official capacity; a woman who is in charge of a particular event or place and who welcomes and looks after the people who attend.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.tr:
adv. 最小；最少；
adj. 最少的；最小的；
n. 最小；最少；
words.ex: He ran the least among all the runners.
words.ex_cn: 他在所有跑步者中跑得最少。
words.en: You use least to indicate that something is the smallest in amount, degree, or size, or the lowest in importance.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
words.ex_cn: 无论何时你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
words.en: at any or every time that

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.ex: He eats spaghetti for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: Spaghetti is a type of pasta that is long, thin, and solid, originally from Italy.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.ex: He added a spoonful of sugar to his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他往茶里加了一勺糖。
words.en: The amount that a spoon can hold.

words.tr: n. 切片；薄片；部分；片段；
words.ex: She ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片面包。
words.en: A slice of something is a thin piece or portion of it.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: He lives on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个小岛上。
words.en: An island is a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.

words.ex: He bought a flower for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妻子买了一朵花。
words.en: A wife is a married woman considered in relation to her husband.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.tr: adj. 出生的；天生的； v. 生（孩子）；“bear”的过去分词；
words.ex: He is a born teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是个天生的老师。
words.en: When a baby is born, it comes out of its mother's body at the beginning of its life.

words.tr: phrase. 逐个地；一个接一个地；依次地
words.ex: The children left the room one by one.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: Individually and in succession; one after another.

words.ex: We eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节吃火鸡。
words.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated primarily in the United States and Canada as a day of giving thanks for the blessing of the harvest and of the preceding year.

words.tr: phrase. 过桥米线（一种源自中国云南的传统米线菜肴，通常包含热汤、生肉片、蔬菜和米线，食用时将配料倒入热汤中烫熟）
words.ex: He eats guoqiao rice noodles for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃过桥米线。
words.en: A famous Chinese dish consisting of rice noodles served in a hot, sour broth.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: He eats a grape every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗葡萄。
words.en: A grape is a small, round fruit that grows in bunches on a vine. Grapes can be green, red, or purple and are used for making wine, eating fresh, or drying into raisins.

words.ex: He is thin.
words.ex_cn: 他很瘦。
words.en: Having a small distance between opposite sides; not thick.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己。
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.ex: You should clean your room yourselves.
words.ex_cn: 你们应该自己打扫房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when this is the same as the subject of the clause and the subject is you.

words.ex: He is an engineer who builds bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名建造桥梁的工程师。
words.en: An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: He is a musician who plays the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位弹吉他的音乐家。
words.en: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument, especially as a profession, or is musically talented.

words.ex: The fireman saved the cat from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 消防员从树上救下了那只猫。
words.en: A fireman is a person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people from dangerous situations, especially in buildings.

words.ex: He uses ai to help with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他用人工智能来帮助做作业。
words.en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think like humans and mimic their actions.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做某事；持续不断地做某事
words.ex: He keeps on asking the same question.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地问同一个问题。
words.en: To continue doing something without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力而为；竭尽全力
words.ex: I will try my best to finish the homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 我会尽力按时完成作业。
words.en: To make the greatest possible effort to achieve something.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: The photographer took pictures of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这位摄影家拍了日落的照片。
words.en: A photographer is a person who takes photographs, especially as a job.

words.ex: The painter draws a beautiful house.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家画了一座美丽的房子。
words.en: A painter is someone who paints pictures, or someone whose job is to paint surfaces such as walls and doors.

words.ex: The businessman sold his products to many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人把他的产品卖到了许多国家。
words.en: A businessman is a man who works in business, especially at a high level.

words.ex: The actress sings in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位女演员在电影中唱歌。
words.en: An actress is a woman whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.tr:
v. 错过；想念；漏掉；
n. 小姐；
words.ex: I missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: To fail to hit, reach, catch, or otherwise make contact with something; to feel the absence or loss of someone or something.

words.ex: He is tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To feel that you have had enough of someone or something and do not want to have to deal with them or it any more.

words.tr: adj. 能够；能…的；有能力的；
words.ex: He is able to swim across the river.
words.ex_cn: 他能够游过这条河。
words.en: If you are able to do something, you have the skills, strength, knowledge, or other qualities needed to do it.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.tr: adj. 卡住的；受困的； v. 粘贴；“stick”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The door is stuck and won't open.
words.ex_cn: 门卡住了，打不开。
words.en: If something is stuck in a particular position, it is fixed tightly in this position and is unable to move.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持某事；忠于某事；不放弃某事
words.ex: You should stick to your plan and not give up.
words.ex_cn: 你应该坚持你的计划，不要放弃。
words.en: To continue doing or using one particular thing and not change to anything else.

words.ex: The resolution of the conflict took many meetings.
words.ex_cn: 这个冲突的解决花了多次会议。
words.en: A resolution is a formal decision made at a meeting by the vote of the people who are there. It can also refer to a firm decision to do or not to do something.

words.ex: I have a book.
words.ex_cn: 我有一本书。
words.en: To possess, own, or hold something.

words.ex: He set a mini-goal to read five pages every day.
words.ex_cn: 他设定了一个小目标，每天读五页。
words.en: A small, short-term objective that contributes to a larger goal.

words.tr: v. 完成；实现；达到；获得；
words.ex: He worked hard to achieve his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以完成他的目标。
words.en: To achieve something means to reach a particular goal or result through effort, skill, or courage.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.ex: She eats healthily every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都健康地饮食。
words.en: In a way that is good for your health.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.ex: He practices self-improvement every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在进行自我提升。
words.en: Self-improvement refers to the process by which a person improves their knowledge, status, or character by their own efforts.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.tr: adj. 有组织的； v. 组织；“organize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She is an organized student who keeps her books in order.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有条理的学生，把书整理得井井有条。
words.en: If something is organized, it is arranged in an orderly, efficient way.

words.ex: He wisely saved money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他明智地为将来存钱。
words.en: In a way that shows good judgment or the benefit of experience.

words.ex: It is possible to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 快速学会英语是可能的。
words.en: If something is possible, it can be done or achieved.

words.ex: He wrote a short paragraph about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段关于他假期的短文。
